name: mine-plan-3d
description: Convert 2D underground mine plans into navigable 3D models assembled from reusable tunnel assets.
author: Nicholas William Davies

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared --noEmit && tsc -p server --noEmit && tsc -p client --noEmit
